decision_note: Honest architecture verdict. No required production capability may be claimed from partial PASS. GO is withheld until every required capability is proven PASS; GO would still not authorize a production cutover.

limitations.reason: Rebooting the maintainer host is not authorized; the D15-4 and D15-5 contracts mark host-reboot OPTIONAL NOT_RUN. D15-3 only models the host-reboot path at the persistence seam, and a container/adapter restart is not a host reboot. It is a limitation, not a required blocker.
limitations.smallest_option: An authorized real host reboot qualification in the isolated runtime, owned by R6.

blocker_details.reason: The composed native spawn provider runs children in-process, so a child-only SIGKILL while the parent executor stays alive is not isolatable. child-run-fault is supporting evidence only and is not used as a substitute.
blocker_details.smallest_option: An out-of-process continuable child provider or the isolated runtime-adapter stack with a real DSH child process.

blocker_details.reason: The committed byq_delegate_* composition loads with enableRunInBackground=false and never calls startContinuable(); no committed BYQ surface cold-resumes a continuable child after an adapter restart.
blocker_details.smallest_option: A product-semantics durable-background-child contract plus a native out-of-process continuable provider; recorded as Proposed ADR-0082 and NOT implemented.

blocker_details.reason: An adapter restart kills the DSH runtime; native terminal sessions are process-local and the committed BYQ tree persists no TerminalAttachment, so a fresh adapter rejects the old attachment.
blocker_details.smallest_option: A BYQ TerminalAttachment lifecycle over the native owner-scoped ctx.terminals seam (R4); recorded as Proposed ADR-0083 and NOT implemented.

blocker_details.reason: A restarted DSH runtime is a new process and native terminal sessions do not survive it; no BYQ reconnect surface exists.
blocker_details.smallest_option: The same BYQ attachment layer plus an explicit lost/interrupted status; never a fabricated reattach.

aggregate_notes.subagent-resume: Display-only aggregate derived from the atomic subagent-child-crash and subagent-byq-adapter-restart capabilities; BLOCKED because a member is BLOCKED. Not an independent actionable blocker.
aggregate_notes.terminal-persistence: Display-only aggregate derived from the atomic terminal-client-reattach, terminal-adapter-restart and terminal-dsh-runtime-restart capabilities; BLOCKED because a member is BLOCKED. Not an independent actionable blocker.
